Exchange (old gold bought elsewhere and at Tanishq) exceeds 50% of jewellery business.
Jewellery product mix reclassified: colour stone moved from studded to gold category.
International business excluding Damas earns 5-6% EBIT margin; Damas is loss-making.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹26,920 Cr, net profit ₹1,179 Cr (+35.4% YoY).
Titan Company held its Q4 and FY26 earnings call on May 8, 2026, highlighting a resurgence in buyer growth and profitability in international operations.
Titan Company Limited announced its Institutional Investors & Analyst Meet 2026 on June 4, 2026, in Mumbai from 8:30 AM to 2:00 PM IST.
CARE Ratings reaffirmed Titan Company's long-term and short-term bank facilities and commercial paper at CARE AAA/A1+, while enhancing total rated bank limits to ₹17,015 Cr.
Titan Company fully redeemed ₹1,000 Cr commercial papers issued on 24th April 2026.
Titan fully redeemed its ₹1,000 Cr commercial paper (ISIN INE280A14591) on 19 October 2026 and paid all holders at maturity.
Titan incorporated Titan Company Canada Inc. as a wholly owned subsidiary on October 27, 2026, to expand its jewellery and lifestyle retail business in Canada.
